## User question addressed

## Canonical records changed
List stable IDs and related use cases, cases or exceptions. Extend an existing record rather than duplicate it in a browse page.

## Sources and assessment
State which sources were checked, what is newly established and what remains unknown. Disclose conflicts of interest and publication rights.

## Validation
Run `python scripts/maintain_catalogue.py --write` and `python scripts/maintain_catalogue.py`, or ask a maintainer to do so. Identify remaining link or metadata issues. These checks do not establish semantic or licensing correctness.
